generation_guards: Depict exactly one dog, exactly three sheep, and exactly seven candles.
Bind colors correctly: the single dog is blue, all three sheep are white, and all seven candles are white.
Maintain spatial relations: the blue dog is on top of the three white sheep; the three white sheep are behind the seven white candles.
Keep all objects clearly visible and separated enough to count; avoid candles fully hiding the sheep and avoid the dog obscuring the sheep completely.
Do not add extra dogs, sheep, or candles.
initial_plan.generation_strategy: Use a clear layered composition with seven white candles in the foreground, three white sheep in a row behind the candles, and one blue dog visibly standing or sitting on top of the three sheep. Emphasize countable separation and correct color binding for each object group.

On top of the three white sheep is exactly one blue dog, clearly visible, with the dog positioned above and supported by the sheep. No additional dogs, sheep, or candles. Ensure the single dog is blue, all three sheep are white, and all seven candles are white.
